hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: In a two-player turn-based game, both players aim to maximize their advantage.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: When a player chooses between the first and last available token, the relative score differential is maximized.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Compute the optimal relative difference using an interval reduction table.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Computes optimal values for each of the O(n^2) interval subproblems in constant time per interval.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A brute force approach would exceed time limits by redundantly reprocessing states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Balances linear traversal with auxiliary tracking structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects an optimal linear or logarithmic solution with edge-case handling.
